demo.question: What can a 2 m observer at 45.98365, 7.78474 see within 10 km?

plan.explanation: What a 2 m observer at 32T MR 0587 9294 can see within 10 km (Copernicus 30 m).

steps: Reading the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM within 10 km
Tracing sight lines from a 2 m observer to 2 m targets
demo.answer: A 2 m observer here can see about 7708 ha (25%) of the ground within 10 km. Buildings and trees in the 30 m elevation model block views; small obstacles are missed.
